name: reasonix-orchestrator
description: Let Codex supervise safe, bounded Reasonix coding workers locally or over SSH.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded work through a local Reasonix MCP.
interface.longDescription: Codex supervises a Mac-local stdio MCP server that delegates bounded research, review, implementation, or verification tasks to Reasonix on this Mac or an explicitly named SSH host. Includes separate probe, read-only, and explicitly authorized write tools plus structured results and independent verification guidance.
defaultPrompt: Use Reasonix to inspect this bug, then verify its findings.
Delegate independent repository research to Reasonix.
Have Reasonix implement this bounded change and verify it.
